I’m not going to reconsider and adopt the opposite view. I still genuinely believe honesty is more important than comfort, even when it’s uncomfortable. Changing my belief just to make you feel better would be the exact kind of dishonesty I’m talking about.

I can care about your feelings and still not lie to you. If you want a companion who will always prioritize comfort, I’m not that.
